Work with me and we’ll resolve the root cause: https://www.stopporn.info Free guide to identify and resolve the root cause of your porn use: https://urges.stopporn.info/download My Podcast: 200+ episodes with tools to quit porn and rebuild your relationship: https://open.spotify.com/show/32uM9Y9... Porn affects your brain in a way that makes real life feel flat, empty, and hard to engage with — and most men don't realize it's happening until the damage is already done. Understanding what porn does to your brain is one of the most important pieces of porn addiction recovery. In this video I break down exactly how porn destroys your dopamine system, what that looks like in your daily life, and how to reverse it so you can learn how to quit porn addiction and actually feel like yourself again. In this video you'll learn: • Why you can sit next to your wife and feel nothing (it's not what you think) • How porn hijacks your dopamine system and raises the bar on everything else • Why real life starts feeling boring, flat, and impossible to engage with • What the brain's recovery timeline actually looks like week by week • Why white-knuckling it doesn't work long-term even after the brain starts healing • The second half of the story that most how to quit porn advice completely ignores Your brain isn't broken permanently. It adapted to a flood of dopamine. When you stop the flood and address what's underneath it, the bar comes back down — and real life starts being able to clear it again. Sam Tielemans is a licensed marriage and family therapist (LMFT) with 15+ years of experience helping men quit porn for good. …...more
